subject: general
question: Name the person who was appointed as the first Surveyor General of India in 1815.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Colin Mackenzie.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In 1815, Colin Mackenzie** was appointed as the **first Surveyor General of India.**
 
• He holds this post from** 1815 to 1821.**
